The main takeaway from our work is that
polymyxin B-tobramycin hybrid antibiotics are potent against MDR/XDR Gram-negative pathogens and synergize with existing antibiotics.

the polymyxin B-tobramycin hybrid 1a is an effective antimicrobial agent with activity against multidrug- and extensively drug-resistant Pseudomonas and Acinetobacter clinical isolates, and is able to potentiate the activity of rifampicin, minocycline, or vancomycin against these pathogens.
antimicrobial hybrids composed of aminoglycosides linked to polymyxins can be potent against Gram-negative pathogens and can also synergize with existing antibiotics.
